title: Determination 2014/015: proposed balustrade barrier beside a car pad, Ngaio, Wellington
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: NZ Building Code, Schedule 1 of the Building Regulations 1992, as cited (Clause F4 and its Acceptable Solution paragraph)

facts.text: Owners G and K Wishart (applicants) and Wellington City Council (authority) for a house at 20 Rothsay Road, Ngaio.
The matter is whether the proposed barrier to a vehicle access way and hard standing complies with Clause F4 (Safety from Falling), with respect to restricting passage of children under 6.

The car pad is newly constructed on a steeply sloping site; the east timber retaining wall is 1.5 m high at its highest point, the fall to the pedestrian path exceeds 1.5 m, and a 200 mm nib wall serves as the vehicle safety barrier.
The final barrier design had not been decided; the dispute was whether balusters in a proposed design could be more than 100 mm apart.
